author: SickProdigy
description: Provider-neutral, Base-first smart wallet integration for Red-DiscordBot.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores wallet profile identifiers, linked platform identifiers, public wallet addresses, and public transaction status metadata. It never stores private keys, recovery phrases, wallet passwords, or one-time authentication codes.
install_msg: This cog is an early Base Sepolia prototype. Configure its HTTPS companion service with `[p]walletset approvalurl` before enrollment is enabled. Do not use it with real funds.
